description: React component for editing and managing prompt messages with drag-and-drop reordering, including message roles and content editing.

methods.name: handleDragStart
methods.description: Sets the index of the message being dragged.

methods.name: handleDragOver
methods.description: Prevents default and sets the index over which the dragged item is hovering.

methods.name: handleDrop
methods.description: Handles dropping a dragged message onto a new position, triggering reordering.

methods.name: handleDragEnd
methods.description: Resets drag state after dragging ends.
